water_need.title: Kerala Agricultural University, fruit crop package (aftercultivation)
water_need.quote: Irrigate twice a week during summer months till the plants are 4-5 years old.
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering every 7-10 days or less once established is 'low', every few days 'medium'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

years_to_bear.title: NHB: Mango
years_to_bear.quote: The orchard starts bearing from sixth year onwards
years_to_bear.note: The page says grafted plants start bearing early without a number; the NHB figure (sixth year) is used. Agronomist to confirm.

water_l_per_sqm_day.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
water_l_per_sqm_day.quote: Daily water requirement of various fruit crops is given below: Crops Water requirement (lit/day/plant) Mango 30-50 Banana 20-25 Citrus 22-30 Guava 22-30 Sapota 20-30 Amla 15-25 Grapes 15-25 Papaya 15-25 For the young trees which are in their pre bearing stage, 1/3rd of the recommended dose of water may be given
water_l_per_sqm_day.note: 30 litres per tree per day (lower end of the range; 'Citrus' is used for orange) over the library's 9.0 m x 9.0 m spacing = 0.37 L per m² per day; young trees get one third. Agronomist to confirm.

source_notes: AI research batch 4 (2026-10-05). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Batch 4 (trees, border and flowers). Planting windows are the source's months (Tamil Nadu or Kerala) until a Malwa source is found. Years to first fruit not found in a checkable source yet.
